images.name: cnpg-postgres
images.summary: CloudNativePG-compatible PostgreSQL, built from PGDG source by melange.
images.description: PostgreSQL built from the PGDG source tarball by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi. Drop-in for CloudNativePG clusters, with a sha-pinned ClusterImageCatalog.

images.name: cloudnative-pg
images.summary: CloudNativePG operator manager, built from upstream source.
images.description: The CloudNativePG Kubernetes operator, compiled from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi. Scanned with grype, cosign-signed when clean.

images.name: cilium
images.summary: Cilium eBPF networking agent, built from upstream source.
images.description: The Cilium agent for eBPF-based Kubernetes networking, security and observability, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: cilium-operator-generic
images.description: The cloud-agnostic Cilium operator that manages IPAM and cluster-wide state, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: cilium-envoy
images.summary: Cilium's Envoy proxy build, pinned to the agent's release.
images.description: The Cilium Envoy proxy for L7 policy and ingress, following the pin in Cilium's own release. Built by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: cert-manager-controller
images.summary: cert-manager controller, built from upstream source.
images.description: The cert-manager controller that issues and renews X.509 certificates in Kubernetes, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: cert-manager-cainjector
images.summary: cert-manager CA injector for webhooks and API services.
images.description: The cert-manager cainjector that injects CA bundles into webhooks and API services, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: cert-manager-webhook
images.summary: cert-manager admission webhook, built from upstream source.
images.description: The cert-manager admission webhook that validates and mutates cert-manager resources, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: metallb-controller
images.summary: MetalLB controller, built from upstream source.
images.description: The MetalLB controller that assigns and reconciles LoadBalancer IP pools in Kubernetes, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: metallb-speaker
images.summary: MetalLB speaker, built from upstream source.
images.description: The MetalLB speaker that announces LoadBalancer IPs on the local network via Layer 2 or BGP, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: metallb-frr-k8s
images.summary: frr-k8s, MetalLB's FRR integration, built from upstream source.
images.description: frr-k8s, the FRR routing integration MetalLB's BGP backend runs on, built from upstream source by melange and assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: openbao
images.summary: OpenBao secrets manager, built from upstream source.
images.description: OpenBao, the open source secrets manager forked from Vault. The bao binary is built from upstream source by melange; the image is assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: dokuwiki
images.summary: DokuWiki plain-file wiki on Wolfi apache2 + mod_php.
images.description: DokuWiki, the plain-file wiki that needs no database, packaged from the pinned release tarball by melange and served by Wolfi apache2 with mod_php.

images.name: grafana-image-renderer
images.description: Grafana Image Renderer v5, a static Go server driving headless Chromium to render panels to PNG and PDF. Built by melange, assembled by apko on Wolfi.

images.name: os-shell
images.summary: Nonroot helper shell for init containers — a bitnami os-shell counterpart.
images.description: A tiny nonroot helper image with bash, curl, jq and yq for Kubernetes init containers, sidecars and one-off shell tasks, assembled by apko from Wolfi packages only.

images.name: k8s-sidecar
images.summary: kiwigrid/k8s-sidecar (Grafana dashboards sidecar) built from source; Wolfi’s package is stale.
images.description: The Grafana dashboard sidecar that syncs ConfigMaps/Secrets to files, built from the upstream release tarball into a self-contained venv and assembled by apko on Wolfi. Drop-in for ghcr.io/kiwigrid/k8s-sidecar: USER 65534, same entrypoint and CLI contract.
